feedback.problem: What are the parametric equations of the hyperbola ${x}^{2}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{9}=1?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The parametric equations of a horizontal hyperbola with Cartesian equation

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1
$$

are given by

$$
x=a\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=b\operatorname{tan}⁡t.
$$

In our case, $a=1$ and $b=\sqrt{9}=3.$ Therefore, the parametric equations are

$$
x=\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=3\operatorname{tan}⁡t.
$$
